subject.title: Optionally show runtime status after /new and /reset

question: Should OpenClaw add the default-off `commands.showRuntimeStatusOnReset` config key for `/new` and `/reset` acknowledgements, or keep `/status` and `/model status` as the supported inspection flow?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and default-off, but adding another public command config surface is a product/API choice that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept The Config Key
options.body: Approve the default-off setting, require a conflict refresh, and land the feature with the existing chat/Gateway/docs coverage preserved.

options.title: Decline The New Knob
options.body: Close or pause the PR and leave users to run `/status` or `/model status` after reset when they need runtime detail.

recommendation.title: Accept The Config Key
recommendation.body: Approve the default-off setting, require a conflict refresh, and land the feature with the existing chat/Gateway/docs coverage preserved.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the central reset acknowledgement behavior and Gateway fast path this product choice extends.
